title: Rito Ra Le Mahlweni Ka Xidzedze
intro: Munhu un’wana emananga u pfukile leswaku a vitana tiko leri nga ni matimba leswaku ri tlhelela entiyisweni. Vanhu a va tiveka hi miako ya vona yo hlamarisa ni matimba lama nga ringanisiwiki na nchumu. Hambi swi ri tano ku tikukumuxa ka vona ku va pfala mahlo, va ala ku yingisa. Eku heteleleni, nxupulo lowu vavisaka wu va werile, va ponisa ntlawa wutsongo wa vapfumeri ntsena.
clues: Ndzi rhumeriwe eka vanhu va matimba lava a va tshama ematikweni lama pfulekeke naswona a va tiviwa hi matimba ya vona.
Vanhu va mina va tile endzhaku ka tiko rin’wana lerikulu leri loviweke.
A va ri ni swivumbeko swo hlamarisa naswona va ake swihondzo leswi tlakukeke.
Ndzi va vitanile leswaku va ta gandzela Xikwembu Xin’we, kambe va arile ku tshika swifaniso swa vona.
Nxupulo wa tihanyi wu va fikelerile, ku ponisa lava pfumelaka na mina ntsena.
Hi mina loyi a rhumeriweke eka vanhu va matimba lava tiviwaka hi vito ra Aad.

arabic: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَزَادَكُمْ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ بَصْۜطَةًۭ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verse: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed." (7:69)
